aj: ran overnight kernel sweeps across A100/H100/L40S, seq=[128,512,1024,2048], batch=[1,4,8,16]. found a consistent 15-25% p95 latency regression on H100 for seq=2048 & batch>=8 when lazy-kv-prefetch is ON and kernel_selector picks the fused-attn-v2 variant.

bench-bot: summary CSV uploaded -> https://ci.internal/bench/1964000123 (csv + flamegraphs). H100 p95 up 22%, avg tokens/sec down ~18%. A100/L40S unaffected.

maria: can you paste the exact command/config you used?

aj: running with:```bash
./bench_tool --model gptx --device h100 --seq 2048 --batch 8 \  --attn-variant fused-attn-v2 --kv-policy lazy-prefetch --kernel-selector tiered
```
also tried: `--kv-policy disabled` and that restored baseline perf.

vlad: interesting. sounds like the selector picks fused-attn-v2 for mem footprint heuristics. with lazy prefetch we may be stalling on async prefetch completion + cross-SM memcpys on H100. H100's L2 behavior differs from A100 which could explain hw-specific regression.

sam: any profiling? nvprof / nsight results?

aj: attached light profile (flamegraph link in CI). top line shows spikes in memcpy async + threadblocks waiting on atomic counters around cache-commit.

maria: could be our KV spill path triggering a fallback that increases SM divergence. do we see increased kernel launch counts?

aj: yes, kernel launches + small-copy kernels increase ~2.5x. registers spilled slightly more on fused-attn-v2.

vlad: theory: selector heuristic uses (seq * batch * head_size) threshold and prefers fused-attn-v2 when estimated workspace < X. H100's true workspace with lazy prefetch > estimator because of queued prefetch buffers, so we get more mem traffic than budgeted.

vlad: short-term mitigation: lower threshold for fused-attn-v2 on H100, or force immediate prefetch (no lazy). I'll sketch change.

sam: can you run quick A/B? set env KERNEL_SELECTOR_DEBUG=1 to log picked kernels.

aj: did two quick runs:
- lazy-prefetch + selector(default) -> p95 +22%
- immediate-prefetch + selector(default) -> p95 +4%
- lazy-prefetch + selector(tighter-h100) -> p95 +3%
so immediate prefetch or selector tweak fixes it.

maria: good repro. can we add a small perf test to catch this in future? maybe add a regression case: h100 seq=2048 batch=8 kv=lazy.

vlad: agreed. I'll open PR to 1) add selector tweak gated by device==H100 2) add regression test in perf-suite 3) add a NOTE in selector docs.

vlad: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/7890 (WIP) :eyes:

aj: running longer sanity run now (overnight) to ensure no regressions on other seq/batch combos.

sam: if PR looks good post-canary we should backport to the 1.2.x branch.

maria: also add a short blurb in release notes about kernel-selection heuristics for H100. ops will want heads up.

aj: thanks all. action items: vlad PR + perf test, aj run full sweep, sam plan canary. I'll pin the bench CSV in the ticket. :thumbsup:
